body.statement: Under \(D_L^{\mathrm G}\), \(\mathbb E[X_s^{\infty}]=0\), \(\mathbb E[X_s^{\infty}X_t^{\infty}]=\mathbf 1\{s=t\}\), and \(\mathbb E[X_{t_1}^{\infty}X_{t_2}^{\infty}X_{t_3}^{\infty}X_{t_4}^{\infty}]=\Theta_L(t_1,t_2,t_3,t_4)\) for all integer indices. Every affine Boolean block \(W\) satisfies \(|C_{L,h}(W)|\le h\) for \(1\le h\le d<L/2\), so \(\operatorname{tr}(M_L+H_d)\le\sum_{h=1}^{d}(h^2+h)\). Moreover, \(T^{-1}\mathbb E[C_T(X^{\infty})C_T(X^{\infty})^{\top}]\to(M_L+H_d)/L\). Equivalently, \(B\) complete blocks have lag-sum covariance \(B M_L+(B-1)H_d\), and all covariances between internal and boundary lag sums vanish.
body.justification: This is the coefficient-level fourth-moment and endpoint certificate needed to transfer a classical code into a one-path causal randomization law.
body.gap: Golay and Davis--Jedwab prove complementary autocorrelation identities, and Mazáč proves infinite Rudin--Shapiro correlation recurrences; none supplies this independent-block random-phase tensor and boundary covariance.
body.consumer: The certificate makes the design auditable and yields exact risk for the actual zero-prehistory moment estimator rather than a circular surrogate.
